name: Graniteshares Short Term Lockbox ETF
desc: The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund (“ETF”) that seeks to achieve its investment objective through multiple combinations of synthetic long and short exchange-listed options positions, each known as a box spread (“Box Spread”) and collectively referred to as box spreads (“Box Spreads”). It is non-diversified.
